tables.name: task_execution_events
columns: execution_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
execution_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(execution_revision>0)
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('start','end','manual_cancel','rfc_terminal_terminate','source_terminal_consequence','correction'))
effective_at_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(effective_at_utc IS NULL OR effective_at_utc>=0)
target_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_execution_events(execution_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
correction_action TEXT NULL CHECK(correction_action IS NULL OR correction_action IN ('replace_time','withdraw'))
reason_code TEXT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
UNIQUE(task_id,execution_revision)
rules: append-only

execution_revision is the immutable per-Task mutation sequence: first event is 1 and every accepted execution mutation appends exactly prior projection revision+1 with no gaps; recorded_at_utc and execution_event_id never order execution authority

correction targets an exact prior non-correction base event with a strictly smaller execution_revision and never updates/deletes it; allowed owner code may re-correct the same still-effective base event by appending a later correction
a correction target must belong to the same Task and be current-effective at the reviewed execution revision; already withdrawn evidence cannot be corrected as if current
generic execution correction may not withdraw rfc_terminal_terminate or source_terminal_consequence because those base events are bound to separate governed terminal decisions
actual execution is never created from Task plan, Objective envelope or provider Complete

tables.name: task_execution_projection
columns: task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
execution_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(execution_state IN ('not_started','in_progress','ended','terminated'))
actual_start_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(actual_start_utc IS NULL OR actual_start_utc>=0)
actual_end_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(actual_end_utc IS NULL OR actual_end_utc>=0)
effective_termination_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(effective_termination_utc IS NULL OR effective_termination_utc>=0)
termination_reason TEXT NULL
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_execution_events(execution_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: rebuildable from task_execution_events ordered by execution_revision
for any positive authority, projection revision equals execution-event count and the final contiguous event execution_revision; last_event_id equals that final event
ended requires accepted start and end with end>=start
manual cancelled-without-execution remains no actual_start

tables.name: task_outcome_events
columns: outcome_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
accepted_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(accepted_outcome IN ('completed','incomplete','cancelled_without_execution'))
correction_of_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_outcome_events(outcome_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
reason_code TEXT NULL
reviewed_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reviewed_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: append-only

the first accepted outcome event for a Task has correction_of_event_id null; every later material correction points to the exact current task_outcome_current.outcome_event_id for the same Task, so accepted outcome history is one linear chain and cannot branch from a stale prior review
reviewed_at and outcome_event_id UUID lexical order are recording/identity evidence only and never establish correction chronology
cancelled_without_execution requires no accepted start under current corrected execution projection
database insert guards reject a correction whose target is not the exact same-Task current outcome tip; owner code also fails closed when current projection/history count or chain integrity disagrees

tables.name: task_outcome_current
columns: task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
outcome_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES task_outcome_events(outcome_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
accepted_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(accepted_outcome IN ('completed','incomplete','cancelled_without_execution'))
reviewed_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reviewed_at_utc>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: row absence is valid only with exact absence of owned task_outcome_events; any positive outcome history requires one current row

current revision equals owned outcome-event count/linear-chain length; outcome_event_id is the exact chain tip; accepted_outcome/reviewed_at/last_command_id agree with that tip; every material correction advances revision exactly once

insert guard requires revision 1, exactly one same-Task genesis event with correction_of_event_id null and exact field/command binding; update guard requires prior revision+1, exact event count, and a new event whose correction_of_event_id equals the old current tip
projection/history disagreement fails closed and may never be interpreted as absent or reviewed

a current row whose accepted outcome ceases to satisfy corrected execution remains immutable latest reviewed evidence but is not a valid current Task outcome for review/Objective derivation until governed outcome correction resolves it
row absent plus due/terminal execution yields derived Awaiting Review; Awaiting Review is not persisted as accepted_outcome

tables.name: task_lock_events
columns: lock_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
lock_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lock_kind IN ('plan','membership'))
action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('lock','unlock'))
reason_code TEXT NOT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: append-only explicit lock history
derived locks from execution/provider terminal/protected history cannot be undone by an explicit unlock event

tables.name: task_lock_projection
columns: task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
explicit_plan_lock INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(explicit_plan_lock IN (0,1))
explicit_membership_lock INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(explicit_membership_lock IN (0,1))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_lock_events(lock_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: effective lock is derived from this projection plus accepted execution/source-terminal/history state
